title: Philippine Birds Calendar
summary: A 2022 wall calendar featuring a different native Philippine bird each month.
description: A landscape wall calendar where each month features a native Philippine bird, with a short note about the species.
Each month's accent colour is drawn from that bird's plumage, and a curved photo frame keeps the dates and the photo balanced on every page.

images.caption: Cover
images.alt: Cover of a 2022 wall calendar with two bald eagles around a white circle reading "Calendar 2022".

images.caption: January
images.alt: January 2022 page with a Black-naped Monarch, a small blue bird perched on a branch, and a note about the species.

images.caption: February
images.alt: February 2022 page with a Blue-capped Kingfisher, a colourful kingfisher found only on Mindanao.

images.caption: March
images.alt: March 2022 page with a Blue-naped Parrot, a bright green parrot found across the Philippines.

images.caption: April
images.alt: April 2022 page with an Elegant Tit, a small yellow and black bird found only in the Philippines.

images.caption: June
images.alt: June 2022 page with a Magnificent Sunbird, a red sunbird perched on a red flower.

images.caption: July
images.alt: July 2022 page with an Oriental Magpie-Robin, a black and white bird singing on a branch.

images.caption: October
images.alt: October 2022 page with a Philippine Hawk-Owl, a small brown owl with yellow eyes.

images.caption: December
images.alt: December 2022 page with a Philippine Hawk-Eagle perched on a branch.
